question.text: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA) read with DPDP Rules 2025, when an AIF collects personal data from an investor for onboarding, the consent obtained from the investor must be:

answer.text: Free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous, with clear and plain language NOTICE describing the personal data, purpose of processing, rights of data principal, and grievance mechanism
Implicit based on signing the subscription form
Given only once at fund inception; no re-consent required for subsequent processing

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, consent for processing personal data is generally framed as needing to be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous, given through a clear affirmative action. The data fiduciary is expected to provide a notice in clear and plain language describing the personal data being collected, the purpose of processing, the way the data principal can exercise rights (such as access, correction, erasure and grievance redressal) and the manner of withdrawing consent. An AIF collecting investor onboarding data is a data fiduciary and is expected to align onboarding consent with this standard. The Trap: Implicit consent based merely on signing a subscription form does not meet the affirmative-action and unambiguous standards usually associated with DPDPA-style consent. A one-time consent at fund inception ignores the need for purpose-linked consent for new processing activities. Restricting the requirement to foreign investors only is incorrect because the DPDPA framework applies to processing of personal data of data principals within India regardless of nationality. Note: The cited workbook chapter on the AIF regulatory framework refers to DPDPA 2023 and the DPDP Rules at a high level but does not contain the exact formulation of consent attributes or the detailed notice contents reflected here. The framing above is based on general DPDPA / DPDP Rules knowledge rather than an explicit workbook citation.
